title: 11 Best Herbal Tinctures For Phlegm
intro: Herbal tinctures for Phlegm are concentrated liquid extracts made from various herbs, plants, and roots that are used to treat respiratory issues and excess mucus production. These natural remedies have been used for centuries to alleviate symptoms of Phlegm, such as congestion, coughing, and difficulty breathing, due to their antibacterial, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties. Examples of herbal tinctures used to treat Phlegm include Echinacea, which boosts the immune system and fights off infections; Thyme, which has antimicrobial properties to combat bacterial infections; Licorice root, which soothes and protects the mucous membranes; Ginger, which reduces inflammation and stimulates digestion; and Hyssop, which helps to expel mucus and phlegm from the lungs. By using these herbal tinctures, individuals can experience relief from Phlegm symptoms and promote overall respiratory health.

preparations.preparation_desc: Eucalyptus globulus tinctures are commonly used in herbal medicine to treat respiratory issues, including excessive phlegm. The properties of this tincture, such as its decongestant and expectorant properties, help to relieve congestion and promote the removal of mucus from the lungs, making it easier to breathe. The bioactive constituents of Eucalyptus globulus, including eucalyptol, limonene, and beta-pinene, possess anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that help to soothe the respiratory tract and reduce inflammation, ultimately alleviating the symptoms of phlegm. Regular use of Eucalyptus globulus tinctures can provide significant relief from phlegm-related ailments, making it a popular natural remedy for respiratory health issues.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Zhongguo Zhong yao za zhi = Zhongguo zhongyao zazhi = China journal of Chinese materia medica", Eucalyptus globulus tinctures for phlegm may be effective in reducing mucin content and hypersecretion of airway mucins, as they significantly decreased mucin content in BALF and MUC5ac expression in trachea and bronchiole epithelium.

By utilizing Echinacea purpurea tinctures, individuals can benefit from a natural remedy that not only helps to alleviate the symptoms of excessive phlegm production but also promotes overall respiratory health and well-being.

preparations.preparation_study: According to "Journal of ethnopharmacology", Zingiber officinale tinctures for phlegm may be effective in inhibiting the AcrAB-TolC efflux pump activity of Salmonella typhimurium, thereby making the bacteria sensitive to antibiotic killing at reduced dosage due to the presence of lariciresinol, a potential efflux pump inhibitor.
